content:
If you're anything like me, you've spent way too much time on Wikipedia, diving down rabbit holes of random articles, going deeper and deeper. Now there's finally an official app—well, more of a widget—that lets you do exactly that.

Finally, there's a button to open a random Wikipedia article with a single tap.

Today's Wikipedia iOS app update adds a fun and useful new feature: a "Random Article" widget for your iPhone and iPad home screens.

The widget comes in two sizes (large and medium) and features an adorable mascot.

Tap the widget, and it'll instantly take you to a completely random Wikipedia article, launching you straight into random mode.

No need to leave the app and tap the widget again. Just hit the "random" button, and it'll keep you going deeper into the rabbit hole like rolling dice.

Have fun, but remember not to lose track of time! Earlier this year, the Wikipedia app also added a history trivia quiz game.

You can find this new widget in today's update of the Wikipedia iPhone and iPad apps.

Get the most out of your Apple devices.
